description: Akobo Minerals AB (publ) operates as a gold exploration and mining company in Ethiopia. The company has interests in the Segele Gold and Joru Gold deposits located in Akobo Gold District, Southwest Ethiopia. It also holds an exploration license covering 182 square kilometers and a mining license covering 16 square kilometers located in the Gambela region and Dima Woreda, Ethiopia. In addition, the company operates the Shama village water project, provides clean and reliable freshwater. The company was founded in 2009 and is based in Stockholm, Sweden.
